name: Harry Potter · Hogwarts First Year, 1991
description: In September 1991, Hogwarts windows shine above the Black Lake. Some first-years grew up with moving portraits; others rode a magical train for the first time today. Four long tables are set in the Great Hall, and the Sorting Hat still sits on its stool.
title: Harry Potter · Hogwarts First Year, 1991

hp-start-muggleborn.name: Muggle-born first-year
hp-start-muggleborn.description: It is your first time inside Hogwarts. You spent the morning looking for a train. Tonight even the portraits are studying the new students.

hp-start-wizardfamily.name: First-year from a wizarding family
hp-start-wizardfamily.description: Your family told countless stories about the school. Only at the castle doors do you hear how close the lake is to the steps.

hp-start-borrowedbooks.name: First-year with borrowed books
hp-start-borrowedbooks.description: The previous owner marked the end of every chapter. You hold the borrowed books close as the other students file into the castle.

hp-start-well-funded.name: Well-provisioned first-year
hp-start-well-funded.description: Your trunk is fully packed and your family put aside extra spending money. At the castle doors the crowd is louder than any story you heard at home.

hp-start-studious.name: Bookish first-year
hp-start-studious.description: Over the summer you read Magical Theory and two borrowed textbooks. You know the ideas; casting can wait for class. A sheet of questions sits between the pages.
